summary: D1 CPU measurement prototype COMPLETE. Mathematical spec frozen before implementation. NegativeBinomial DGP with 2 mechanism variants. Sequential engine with 5 action types. Trusted evaluator with FDP/Power/Cost. 4 DEV tasks x 2 policies show non-degenerate score variation. 15/15 tests pass. CONDITIONAL GO.
runs_note: DEV smoke only, not official benchmark runs. See results/round_005_d1_dev.json

mechanism_comparison.observation: M2 (confounded) has worse FDP than M1 (unconfounded)

tests.notes: DGP, evaluator, engine, isolation, strategy-invariance tests

acceptance_detail.R5-01: Mathematical spec committed separately (863391e) before implementation.
acceptance_detail.R5-02: DGP with 2 mechanisms (M1 unconfounded, M2 partially confounded). Identifiability check.
acceptance_detail.R5-03: Trusted evaluator separate function. Strategy-identity invariance verified. No hidden truth in public view.
acceptance_detail.R5-04: Raw FDP/Power/Cost correct. All-null, missing answer, false discovery cases tested.
acceptance_detail.R5-05: 4 DEV tasks x 2 policies. Non-degenerate score variation (FDP 0.27-0.70).
acceptance_detail.R5-06: 15/15 tests pass. Reproducible traces. $0 API cost. No Phase1.

decision_rationale: D1 measurement validity demonstrated. Non-degenerate scores, correct FDR accounting, strategy-identity invariance. CONDITIONAL on independent DGP review and process isolation upgrade before multi-domain expansion.
